_comment: Named-tool registry for the x402 buyer MCP. Each entry becomes one MCP tool (packages/x402-mcp/src/tools/named-services.js builds them) that pays a single, fixed three.ws x402 endpoint, instead of the model composing a raw pay_and_call(url) call. Mirrored in api/_mcpagent/named-services-tools.js for the hosted agent. Source of the facts below: api/_lib/service-catalog/services/*.js (order 516).

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.title: Weather Guard: Forecast
tools.description: Pay $0.001 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) for the next 24 hours of hourly temperature, wind speed, precipitation probability and WMO weather conditions at any latitude/longitude, sourced live from Open-Meteo with a US National Weather Service fallback and active NWS severe-weather alerts for US coordinates.

tools.name: weather_go_no_go
tools.title: Weather Guard: Activity Decision
tools.description: Pay $0.002 USDC per call to turn the next 6 hours of live forecast at any lat/lon into a go / caution / no-go verdict for a named activity (running, cycling, outdoor-event, drone-flight, photography), with the exact thresholds crossed and any active NWS severe-weather alert that forced a no-go.

activity.description: Activity to judge the forecast against.

tools.name: carbon_now
tools.title: Grid Carbon: Now
tools.description: Pay $0.001 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) for the current UK national grid carbon intensity in gCO2/kWh with its forecast/actual/index reading and full generation mix, live from the National Grid ESO Carbon Intensity API. Pass a GB postcode outcode for the regional reading instead.

postcode.description: GB postcode outcode, e.g. "SW1A". Omit for the national reading.

tools.name: carbon_best_window
tools.title: Grid Carbon: Best Window
tools.description: Pay $0.002 USDC per call to scan the live 48h National Grid ESO carbon-intensity forecast for the lowest-carbon window of a given length (1 to 12 hours), nationally or for one GB postcode region, with the best window, up to 3 runners-up, the worst window, and a plain-language recommendation.

hours.description: Length of the window to find, in hours.

postcode.description: GB postcode outcode, e.g. "SW1A". Omit for the national forecast.

tools.name: domain_rdap_check
tools.title: Domain Check (RDAP)
tools.description: Pay $0.001 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) to query the authoritative RDAP server for a domain (IANA bootstrap registry, rdap.org fallback) and get its registration status, registrar, creation/update/expiry dates, nameservers, status flags, and DNSSEC signing state.

tools.name: domain_rdap_check_bulk
tools.title: Domain Check (Bulk RDAP)
tools.description: Pay $0.005 USDC per call to check up to 50 domains in one request against their authoritative RDAP servers, with bounded concurrency. Returns a per-domain registration breakdown plus registered/available/unknown counts.

domains.description: Domains to check, 1 to 50 per call.

tools.name: research_search
tools.title: Scholarly Search
tools.description: Pay $0.002 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) to query arXiv, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar in parallel and get a merged, de-duplicated ranking of papers with authors, year, venue, DOI, arXiv id, abstract, and citation count.

tools.name: research_paper
tools.title: Paper Detail & Citation Graph
tools.description: Pay $0.003 USDC per call for a single paper's full metadata (title, abstract, TL;DR, year, venue, authors, fields of study, open-access PDF link) plus a two-sided citation graph, keyed by DOI, arXiv id, or Semantic Scholar id.

id.description: A DOI, arXiv id (e.g. "1706.03762"), or Semantic Scholar paper id.

tools.name: research_bibliography
tools.title: Bibliography Formatter
tools.description: Pay $0.005 USDC per call to get formatted BibTeX and/or APA 7 citation entries for up to 25 DOIs in one request, sourced live from Crossref.

dois.description: DOIs to format, 1 to 25 per call.

tools.name: book_search
tools.title: Book Search
tools.description: Pay $0.001 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) to search OpenLibrary editions by title (and optionally author) and get each edition annotated with whether a cleaned Project Gutenberg full text can be bought with book_read, resolved live via Gutendex with a gutenberg.org fallback.

tools.name: book_read
tools.title: Book Read
tools.description: Pay $0.01 USDC per call to receive the complete text of a public-domain Project Gutenberg book, licence boilerplate stripped and split into chapters, as markdown JSON. Find a gutenbergId with book_search first.

gutenbergId.description: Project Gutenberg ebook id, from book_search.

tools.name: news_wire_search
tools.title: Global News Wire Search
tools.description: Pay $0.003 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) to search the GDELT Project's real-time index of worldwide news media in 65+ languages. Returns matching articles plus a coverage-volume timeline. For an ongoing poll loop, switch to news_wire_poll after the first search.

q.description: Search query. Free text is quoted automatically; GDELT operators (AND, OR, sourcelang:, etc) pass through as-is.

sourceLang.description: Restrict to a GDELT source language code, e.g. eng.

sourceCountry.description: Restrict to a GDELT source country code, e.g. us.

includeTimeline.description: Include the coverage-volume timeline (one extra upstream call).

tools.name: news_wire_poll
tools.title: Global News Wire Pulse
tools.description: Pay $0.002 USDC per call to get only the GDELT articles that have appeared for your query since a cursor you supply, plus a fresh cursor for the next poll. Start with news_wire_search to get a query working, then switch here for ongoing monitoring without re-fetching the same articles.

q.description: Search query, same syntax as news_wire_search.

cursor.description: GDELT timestamp (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) or ISO-8601 timestamp to poll since.

tools.name: transit_plan
tools.title: Transit Trip Plan
tools.description: Pay $0.002 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) to plan a trip between two MBTA stops from the public GTFS feed. Each place accepts a feed stop id, a station name, or a "lat,lon" pair. Returns direct and one-transfer itineraries, with realtime predictions overlaid where the GTFS-Realtime feed has them.

from.description: Origin: stop id, station name, or "lat,lon".

to.description: Destination: stop id, station name, or "lat,lon".

tools.name: transit_delays
tools.title: Transit Delay Snapshot
tools.description: Pay $0.001 USDC per call to see how the MBTA's realtime feed compares to the scheduled timetable right now at a stop, optionally filtered to one route. Returns a per-arrival breakdown plus a running-well / minor-delays / significant-delays verdict. Find a stop id with transit_plan first.

route.description: Optional feed route id to filter by.

tools.name: places_search
tools.title: Places Search
tools.description: Pay $0.002 USDC (or use the free daily per-IP quota) to search OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API for points of interest within a radius of a coordinate, optionally filtered to a category (cafe, restaurant, pharmacy, museum, etc). Returns each place's name, category, coordinates, opening hours, phone, website, address, and cuisine where tagged.

category.description: OSM tag value such as cafe, restaurant, pharmacy, bar, museum.

tools.name: places_detail
tools.title: Place Detail
tools.description: Pay $0.002 USDC per call to fetch the full live OpenStreetMap record for one place, by the id returned from places_search (e.g. "node-1072800838"). Returns every OSM tag alongside the structured fields.
